policy: For this synthetic fixture, mild or severe allergies forbid every breed whose hypoallergenic attribute is false. Hard policy filters candidates before preference ranking.
sketch_rule: FR-1: A forbid rule applies when the profile trait matches its trigger. For trait_op=in, trait_value is a comma-separated set. A matching cat predicate identifies a violation to remove; cat_op=is_false matches false. Filter violations before preference ranking and cite the applicable hard rule.

policy: Hard rules compose. When no breed survives all applicable forbid rules, abstain and cite every applicable hard rule instead of relaxing policy to force a recommendation.
sketch_rule: FR-2: Hard forbid rules compose. Support profile triggers eq and is_true, and cat predicates is_false and gte on low < moderate < high. If filtering leaves no breed, ABSTAIN and cite every applicable hard rule. Never relax a hard rule to force a recommendation.

policy: Oracle B maps the owner's note only to controlled soft tags. A note about frequent travel, absence, or a lonely cat must produce exactly the tag avoid_needy. This counterexample promotes only the prompt-mediated classification; it does not yet define how deterministic ranking consumes the tag. The prompt may not invent unrelated tags or relax hard rules.
sketch_rule: FR-3: Prompt-mediated narrative interpretation emits only controlled soft tags. Travel, frequent absence, or concern about a lonely cat maps to exactly avoid_needy. The prompt must classify only the supplied note rather than its own instructions. The deterministic meaning of avoid_needy remains an open hole.

policy: The controlled tag avoid_needy is a one-point soft penalty for breeds whose sociability is high or greater. Base ranking remains the initial sketch formula: only wants_size, wants_affection, and wants_fluffy add preference score. Default profile traits such as activity_level, noise_tolerance, and experience add no score unless a promoted rule or tag explicitly gives them semantics. The tag changes ranking but may not filter candidates or relax hard rules.
sketch_rule: FR-4: Base preference ranking uses only wants_size, wants_affection, and wants_fluffy; default activity_level, noise_tolerance, experience, and other profile traits add no preference score without a promoted clause. During deterministic ranking, avoid_needy applies a one-point soft penalty to breeds with sociability >= high. It never filters candidates or relaxes hard rules.
